name: 电话和视频会
blurb: 视频会议和打电话里翻来覆去那几句：听不到、静音了、共享屏幕、约时间、改时间。

scenes.title: 开场：大家听得到吗
scenes.situation: 你主持视频会。先问大家能不能听到你，再说等一两分钟让其他人进来就开始。
scenes.model: Hi everyone, can you hear me okay? Let's give it a couple more minutes for others to join, and then we'll get started.

chunks.en: give it a couple more minutes

scenes.title: 提醒对方静音了
scenes.situation: 对方嘴在动，可是没有声音。提醒他开着静音，请他再说一遍。
scenes.model: Sorry, I think you're on mute. Could you say that again?

scenes.title: 网卡了
scenes.situation: 对方的声音断断续续。你说你这边网不太好，先把摄像头关了试试。
scenes.model: Sorry, you're breaking up a bit. My connection isn't great. Let me turn off my camera and see if that helps.

scenes.title: 共享屏幕讲数据
scenes.situation: 你要共享屏幕给大家看数据。问大家看得到吗，再说上个月销售回升了。
scenes.model: Let me share my screen. Can everyone see it? Okay, as you can see, sales picked up last month.

scenes.title: 收尾，定下一步
scenes.situation: 会快到点了。你收个尾：Tom 去改计划，你会后把会议纪要发给大家。
scenes.model: We're almost out of time, so let me wrap up. Next steps: Tom will update the plan, and I'll send out the notes after the call.

scenes.title: 打电话找人
scenes.situation: 打电话到合作方公司，找负责采购的 Linda，说是关于你们订单的事。
scenes.model: Hi, this is David from Sunrise Tech. Could I speak to Linda, please? It's about our order.

scenes.title: 人不在，请她回电
scenes.situation: 对方说 Linda 在开会。你请他转告 Linda 给你回个电话，再留下你的号码。
scenes.model: No problem. Could you ask her to call me back? My number is 138 0000 1234. Thanks a lot.

scenes.title: 没听清，请他慢点
scenes.situation: 对方说得太快你没听清。请他说慢一点，再确认一下：是周四下午三点吗？
scenes.model: Sorry, I didn't catch that. Could you speak a little more slowly? Just to confirm, you said Thursday at three, right?

scenes.title: 约个时间见面
scenes.situation: 打电话约对方下周见一面。问他哪天方便，你周二、周三都可以。
scenes.model: I'd like to set up a meeting next week. What day works best for you? Tuesday or Wednesday both work for me.

chunks.en: What day works best for you?

scenes.title: 临时改时间
scenes.situation: 你临时有事，打电话想把明天的会改到周五，为临时通知道个歉。
scenes.model: I'm so sorry, something came up. Would it be possible to move our meeting to Friday? Sorry for the short notice.

plays.title: 打电话约人
plays.setup: 你打电话给合作方的采购经理 Linda，想约下周见面谈明年的订单。她很忙，时间不好约。
plays.goal: 约到下周一个双方都行的时间，再把时间地点确认一遍。
plays.persona: You are Linda, a busy purchasing manager at a partner company. You speak a bit fast. You are interested in meeting but your schedule is tight: Monday and Tuesday are full, Wednesday afternoon or Friday morning might work. Ask what the meeting is about and whether it can be a video call.

plays.title: 主持视频周会
plays.setup: 你主持每周的视频会，美国团队的 James 要汇报这周进度。他那边网络时好时坏。
plays.goal: 开好场，听完他的汇报，定下一步，按时收尾。
plays.persona: You are James, a team member in the US joining a weekly video meeting. Your connection is sometimes unstable: occasionally reply with something like 'Sorry, you cut out there, could you repeat that?'. Give short progress updates when asked: the new feature is 80% done, one bug is blocking testing, and you need a decision on the release date.
plays.opener: Hi, can you hear me? I think my video is a bit laggy today.
